card.name: Jesuit missionaries before a named companion
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas and titles like Father that come right before the name of a Jesuit missionary or colleague, in historical texts about Francis Xavier and early missions in Asia and America.

modes.label: Before a missionary's name
modes.description: A comma, 'and', 'named' or 'Father' directly ahead of the name of a Jesuit or colleague.

modes.label: After a colleague noun
modes.description: A comma or noun after a word like father or colleague, just before the person is named.
modes.example: by a Jesuit father<<,>> Emanuel Acosta.

card.writes: It seems to suppress church and denomination words such as Protestant, Methodist and Lent, so the next word is a personal name instead.
card.plain: It lights up in old mission histories just before a Jesuit priest's name is given.
